## About
Mōtus Chiropractic is a chiropractic office on Menchaca Rd in South Austin. The approach is simple: a thorough assessment, objective measurements, and care that fits you, without pressure.
If you've been hesitant about seeing a chiropractor, you're not alone. Reviewers describe Dr. Mike as someone who listens, explains the process, and walks you through your X-rays so you know exactly what you're working on. He also teaches stretching and strength building so you can keep making progress between visits.
The office is a calm, quiet place to be, and Melissa, the manager, helps with scheduling. Mōtus holds a 5 rating from 98 Google reviews.

## Services
- Thorough assessments and objective measurements: Your care starts with a careful look at what's going on. One reviewer said Dr. Mike walked them through their X-rays and showed them what they'd be working on.
- Individualized care: A plan built around you, adjusted as you go, and never a hard sell.
- Stretching and strength building: Dr. Mike teaches stretching and strength building techniques so the progress you make in the office lasts outside it.

## FAQ
Q: I'm nervous about seeing a chiropractor. What should I expect?
A: That's a common feeling. One reviewer who had always been hesitant said Dr. Mike explained the process and put their concerns at ease. Care here is offered without pressure.

Q: Will I get to see my X-rays?
A: Yes. One reviewer said Dr. Mike walked them through their X-rays and showed them exactly what they would be working on together.

Q: When is the office open?
A: Monday, Tuesday and Thursday from 8:30 AM to 6:00 PM, with shorter afternoon hours on Wednesday. The office is closed Friday, Saturday and Sunday.
